## Purpose

Describe one clear purpose for this change.

- [ ] no public contract change

## Verification

- [ ] relevant regression added/updated

## Licensing/contribution

External contribution acceptance remains subject to the repository's finalized contributor-rights policy. Submission does not override that policy.
